name: Nishiokoppe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishiokoppe village emblem in white: a triangular device with a ring and curved wings, like a mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Nishiokoppe, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 December 1967.

features.role: Nishiokoppe village emblem — a triangular device with a ring and curved wings, like a mountain
